title: Add the shared completeRequest library boundary
objective: Expose completeRequest(requestDirectory, parameters, options) that loads assets, substitutes values, constructs an existing LlmRequest, and delegates to complete.

branch.name: wi-0018-complete-request-library
branch.rationale: The record captures bounded planning without creating or switching a branch.

request.text: Prepare small, testable work items for dynamic request lookup: document requests/README.md; support request asset discovery; schema-aware CLI parameters including dot/index paths and --parameters JSON; $${variableName}$$ substitution; completeRequest(requestDirectory, parameters); llm req CLI integration; raw/full output; summarize compatibility; provider-free validation; and no commit.

scope.name: exported-api
scope.description: completeRequest is exported with usable types and accepts directory, parameters, and completion controls.
scope.reason: Consumers need a stable programmatic boundary.

scope.name: constructed-request
scope.description: The function creates a valid existing LlmRequest from assets and parameters.
scope.reason: The dynamic layer must not invent a parallel contract.

scope.name: single-delegation
scope.description: Valid input delegates once and invalid input produces zero provider calls.
scope.reason: CLI and library behavior must align.

scope.name: relative-root
scope.description: Relative sources and completion options use requestDirectory and pass through controls.
scope.reason: Bundles need safe local references and runtime controls.

nonGoals.name: implementation
nonGoals.description: Do not implement behavior outside this work item.

nonGoals.name: provider-and-release
nonGoals.description: Do not make authenticated calls, publish, deploy, or claim production readiness.

nonGoals.name: unrelated-refactor
nonGoals.description: Do not redesign unrelated commands, providers, schemas, or persistence.
nonGoals.reason: Scope is limited to dynamic request lookup.
